Parse and structure errors are handled with clear messages.
The view does not change the stored record.

terms.meaning: A structured file of all the disclosed facts about one project.
A stage of a wind project, shown as its own group.
Where a claim came from, such as an uploaded report.
The list of reference documents the claims cite.
Reading text and turning it into structured data.

sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Imports
sections.what: Brings in the state tool, the data-fetching tool and the citation hook.
sections.why: Needed by the rest of this file.

sections.name: Claim, Participant, Dossier
sections.title: Claim, participant and dossier shapes
sections.what: Describes the fields of a claim, a participant and the whole dossier, including the ranking, aliases, numeric policy and any legacy budget kept for audit.
sections.why: Gives the code a fixed shape so the screen reads the data safely.
sections.watch_out: If stored data does not match these fields, parts of the screen show blanks.

sections.name: SECTION_LABELS
sections.title: Section name lookup
sections.what: Maps numeric section codes to readable headings, such as Financial history and cost basis.
sections.why: Reason not stated in the code beyond showing readable headings. The codes stay in the stored data.
sections.watch_out: A code with no entry falls back to the raw code or the not-reported label.

sections.name: WindReference, WindRegisterData
sections.title: Reference and register shapes
sections.what: Describes one reference document (id, title, publisher, links, dates, verification status) and the register wrapper that holds all references and the full raw report.
sections.why: Gives the lookup a fixed shape to read.
sections.watch_out: The verification text is shown as stated. This screen does not verify it.

sections.name: useWindRegister
sections.title: Register loader
sections.what: Loads the wind register from its address only when enabled, and treats it as fresh for five minutes.
sections.why: Likely reason: the register is large and changes rarely, so it is cached and loaded only when needed.
sections.watch_out: Register changes can take up to five minutes to appear.

sections.name: referenceCitation
sections.title: Reference citation builder
sections.what: Turns a reference into a citation whose text clearly says it is reference metadata, not a publisher quotation. Includes its dates, scope and alternate addresses.
sections.why: Stated in the code: the warning keeps readers from treating metadata as a direct quote.
sections.watch_out: The warning text is deliberate. Keep it when editing.

sections.name: WindDossier
sections.title: Dossier screen
sections.what: Draws the whole wind dossier: the parse and structure checks, the summary, search, phase groups with claims and reference buttons, the participants with their evidence buttons, and the citation drawer.
sections.why: Reason not stated in the code beyond showing sourced disclosures.
sections.watch_out: The hook calls must stay above the early returns, or React will fail when the value changes.

summary: Shows a sourced list of wind project disclosures grouped by phase, with search and a button to read the evidence for each claim.
purpose: Lets a reviewer see each wind claim with its value, scope, date and origin, search them, and open the source excerpt or reference document for each.
why: The on-screen text says uploaded claims are kept separate from checked original excerpts, and that the report label is not verification. Existing platform scores are kept apart too.
how: Reads the dossier from text or an object. If it cannot read it, or the claims are not a list, it shows an error. Otherwise it draws a summary, a search box, and claims grouped by phase and section, filtered by the search text. Each claim shows its value, its origin and reference buttons. Reference buttons look up the register to open the document. Participants are listed at the end. Evidence opens through the citation hook.
inputs: value (the dossier as text or an object), projectId and projectName. The reference register is loaded from the wind register endpoint.
outputs: A section on screen with summary, search, phase groups, participants, and the citation drawer.
risks: This shows real claims about real projects, so labels must stay honest. If the register cannot load, claims still show but reference buttons stay disabled.
debug: If nothing shows, check that value is not empty. If the parse message appears, inspect the stored record. If a reference says unresolved, check the id against the register. If search finds nothing, check the text against the fields searched.
